messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a deps sync + lockfile & vendor bump ahead of tomorrow's cutoff (08:00 UTC). I want to run submodule updates + regen lockfiles across Go/Python/Node. Planned flow:

1) update git submodules to pinned commits
2) regen language lockfiles (go mod tidy, poetry lock, yarn)
3) run `make vendor` and commit vendor/ in a separate commit
4) open PR against release/cutoff with only dep changes

Commands I'm about to run:
```
git checkout -b deps/precutoff-sync
git submodule update --init --remote
make vendor
go mod tidy && git add go.mod go.sum
poetry lock && git add pyproject.toml poetry.lock
yarn install --frozen-lockfile && git add yarn.lock
git commit -m "deps: sync submodules and regen lockfiles" -- vendor/ go.mod go.sum poetry.lock yarn.lock
```

Anyone seen gotchas recently? Particularly around submodules pointing at branches vs hashes, or CI complaining about vendor vs go.sum mismatches? :eyes:

alex: Solid. Two quick notes:
- Keep the vendor/ commit isolated (CI treats vendor changes specially; diffs with code changes make bisects painful).
- If any submodule moved via force-push, we'll want to pin to a commit and not to a branch (use `git submodule set-branch --no` or update .gitmodules).
- Rebase onto release/cutoff before opening the PR so the branch build is green.

jon: FYI I hit a gotcha yesterday — upstream submodule repo had an automated bot rewrite that changed tags. I ended up pinning the commit SHA and adding a short note in the PR body explaining why.

lena: Also watch for CI lint job that verifies lockfile freshness. It fails with a message like:
```
ci: lockfile mismatch: go.sum changed but vendor/ not updated
Please run: go mod vendor && git add vendor/ go.sum
```
Make sure to run vendor+tidy in the same branch/commit sequence.

pat: Small process ask: when you open the PR, include a checklist in the description with the three lockfiles + vendor+submodule pins, and tag @eng-releases and @eng-sre so we can watch the infra tests.

maya: Good call, I'll add the checklist and tag SRE. Question: do we prefer a single PR with all language lockfiles + vendor, or one PR per ecosystem?

alex: We usually prefer one PR for the global sync (reduces release churn) but keep the vendor commit as a separate commit within that PR. If you expect the Python regen to introduce unrelated formatting changes, split those out.

ci-bot: build started for branch deps/precutoff-sync (commit abc123)

maya: quick check — submodule remote pulled in a later commit that touches a protobuf gen. Rolling back to the pinned commit and re-running vendor.

jon: If the submodule is breaking generated code, make sure the generated artifacts are within the same commit as the submodule change. Otherwise reviewers will see mismatched generated output.

lena: One more nit — when adding `go.sum`, prefer to include it in the same commit as go.mod change to satisfy the `verify-vendor` CI gate.

pat: I'll keep an eye on the build once you push. If it flakes, we'll stash the change and try the release/cutoff rebase flow.

sre-ops: Reminder: release infra will snapshot images at cutoff. If this PR lands after snapshot time, it'll be excluded and we'll need a manual backfill. Aim to have the PR merged at least 30m before 08:00 UTC.

maya: Pushed branch and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/deps/precutoff-sync
PR description includes checklist, pinned commit SHAs for submodules, and a note about keep-vendor-separate. Tagging reviewers: @alex @lena @pat

ci-bot: check-suite completed — one failure: `verify-vendor` failed on linux-amd64

maya: Error log shows `go.sum` changed but vendor/ missing the new files. Running `go mod vendor` again and updating vendor commit.

alex: After vendor commit, run `bazel clean --expunge` if you're using Bazel to avoid stale caches during CI.

maya: Updated vendor and force-pushed. CI queued.

ci-bot: check-suite passed (all jobs green) :white_check_mark:

pat: Thanks — I'll merge this after the final 30m green window.

lena: Quick follow-up for bookkeeping: create a short changelog entry under Unreleased -> Dependencies noting submodule SHAs and that vendor was regenerated.

maya: Will add changelog blurb and then merge once the countdown hits 30m.

sre-ops: Merged during the window. Monitoring rollout. If anyone sees increased latencies, ping #eng-sre.

jon: Thanks all — smooth run. Next time maybe automate the multi-ecosystem lock regen in CI to reduce manual steps. :thumbsup:
